newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Apr-Jun output seen off 0.7 pct qtr/qtr-MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Apr-Jun output seen off 0.7 pct qtr/qtr-MITI.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Thursday that industrial output in the April-June quarter was expected to fall 0.7 percent quarter-over-quarter but rise 6.1 percent year-on-year.
A MITI official said that the slight fall in production in April was due to a reaction to a rise in Japan's sales tax on April 1 and a slip in production from orders.
Industrial production in April fell a preliminary 0.4 percent from the previous month on a seasonally adjusted basis, contrary to economists' forecasts for a rise.

The official said a change in the ministry's assessment from a rising trend to a gradual rising trend this month reflected strong production growth in the January-March quarter, and it was difficult to foresee the same strength continuing in the current quarter.

He said that the forecast for manufacturers' output in May was revised upwards to an increase of 2.7 percent from a previous prediction of a 1.1 percent rise because of a healthy outlook in the steel and machinery, in particular electric machinery, sectors.
He said that the ministry's forecast fall in manufacturers' output of 1.9 percent for June was due to expected declines in output in the machinery and chemicals industries.
